use: Existing CC0 lacquered-cherry scan supplies metric normal/roughness and normalized grain on independently modeled timber. Red/cedar keep their existing pigment. The veranda floor now also has independent warm red-brown pigment instead of multiplying the dark source brown; the lower rail is real segmented wood. No photo RGB.

materialCalibration.method: Decode via the sRGB texture, divide linear luminance by the measured full-map mean, apply exponent .55 and clamp .52..1.46 as painted grain. Material pigment supplies warm vermilion.
materialCalibration.floorSourceRole: Normalized grain; no raw dark-brown albedo multiplication. Worn/wet clearcoat stays on the actual closed boards.

authoredMetalGeometry.construction: Closed revolved annular webs with thick rounded rims, central spindle, stepped roof boot and seated terminal. Nineteen levels follow the photographed taper/spacing; not torus wire loops.
authoredMetalGeometry.finish: Sorin-only gold/bronze use the existing outdoor sky environment, rather than the veranda-local reflection probe. Other metal remains unchanged.

verandaBoards.scope: Only foreground deck and lowest rail/foot sill. Reference pose, dolly, lighting, building positions, middle/top rails and all upper cast metalwork retained.
verandaBoards.referenceVisibility: HD0-photo1 exposes only a narrow floor strip at the foreground rail; the present native view exposes a larger right-bottom deck. Board end locations and hidden joists cannot be measured from that photo and are explicitly structural hypotheses.
verandaBoards.diagnosis: Prior geometry already had25closed strips and7mm gaps, but each strip was30m long with no end joints or supporting joist detail. Unit rounded-box scaling stretched the end rounding to~0.54m. A full5.9x30m Reflector6mm above the boards, alpha0.71, obscured real floor joints/height. Floor albedo remained the raw near-black scan.
verandaBoards.construction: 25longitudinalZboard columns subdivided into1.2–3.6m staggered closed45mm boards with4mm end gaps,1.5–2.2mm true arrises,±1.2mm top differences, shallow cupping/wear, fixed bottom support contact and small physical fasteners. End joints fall on0.6m transverse joists, with longitudinal bearer solids below.
verandaBoards.lowerRail: Only the lowest rail is segmented with small true bevels/end tenons and a closed wood sill under retained post shafts. Existing middle/top rails, posts and metalwork stay.
verandaBoards.material: Floor pigment#925034 multiplied by normalized source linear luminance/0.01505120736^.55, clamped.52..1.46; scanned normal and roughness retained at metric scale. Actual per-board clearcoat with worn/wet roughness plus the already-captured real scene probe. The deck-spanning Reflector is removed; the pond Reflector remains.
